The wording on the previous edit was editorialism, and tried to misrepresent that Senator Heinrich only lived in Maryland. Anyone familiar with DC knows it's necessary for Senators and Representatives to have a second residence in either Washington, DC, Maryland, or Virginia, because the alternative would be homelessness while working in Washington, DC. In addition to that, a trip from DC to New Mexico is ~14 hours round trip, which would make it impossible to function traveling back and forth.
Dubious if he represents New Mexico

The previous edits were malicious attempts to imply that Senator Heinrich doesn't have a home in the district he represents. This is untrue. He maintains a residence in his home district in New Mexico, and maintains a residence in the Washington DC area(Silver Spring, Maryland) just as pretty much all other representatives, do. The previous edits tried to falsely imply that he only has residence in Maryland.
